name: ChurchWebsites UK
shortDescription: A Coventry-based subscription website platform for churches and ministries, with managed hosting, church-focused templates, events, sermons, forms and optional mobile-app services.
company: MediaWorkx Creative Digital (ChurchWebsites UK trading brand; legal entity details not established in the reviewed material)
suitableContexts: UK churches seeking a managed public website with hosting and support
Churches publishing sermons, events, news and contact forms
Ministries wanting a website service from a church-focused UK supplier

pricing.summary: Published pricing lists a Basic plan at £29.99/month plus a £150 setup fee, or £299.99/year plus setup; and a Pro plan at £49.99/month plus a £250 setup fee, or £499.99/year plus setup. The supplier says UK prices are subject to VAT. Reconfirm the current package, domain, email, storage, mobile-app, payment and cancellation terms in writing before ordering.

gdprInformation: The reviewed pages do not establish a current product-specific DPA, hosting location, sub-processor list, retention schedule or controller/processor allocation for church website content, forms, email accounts or any linked giving service. Obtain these in writing and avoid placing sensitive pastoral, safeguarding or children’s data in public-site forms without an appropriate local process.
integrations: GoCardless is named as the supplier’s Direct Debit payment processor

Supplier states that the subscription website design remains its property
Confirm exact export formats, media completeness, domain transfer and timing before adoption
support: Supplier advertises email, telephone and support-site support
Supplier states support is included with the monthly subscription

uk-operator-context.value: The supplier describes ChurchWebsites UK as part of MediaWorkx Creative Digital, based in Coventry, United Kingdom, and publishes a Coventry contact address and UK telephone number.

pricing.value: Published pricing lists Basic and Pro monthly and annual subscriptions with separate setup fees and states that UK prices are subject to VAT.

product-scope.value: Supplier lists church-specific website capabilities including sermons, events, custom forms, livestream player, social links, blog publishing and media tools.

exit-and-support.value: Supplier says it can export customer content and data following cancellation, while retaining ownership of the subscription website design; it also describes included email, telephone and support-site assistance.

editorial.assessment: ChurchWebsites UK is a church-focused managed website subscription, rather than a general church-management system. It is relevant where a church wants a public site, hosting, media publishing and supplier support bundled together, and its published content-export statement is helpful for assessing exit. The church should distinguish its own content from the supplier-owned subscription design, and make the hosting, form, email, domain, accessibility, payment and data-processing arrangements explicit before moving a live site.

procurementVerdict.problem: Launching and maintaining a church website without separately arranging design, hosting and routine technical help
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK church-focused managed subscription that combines website publishing, hosting, media features and support
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask the supplier for the current agreement, DPA, hosting and backup details, a full export example, domain-transfer process and accessibility approach; then build a representative page, event, sermon and contact-form workflow before moving the live site
